comment: Each string is a waveguide: a delay loop setting the pitch, a low-pass inside the loop so the high partials die first, four allpass sections giving the string stiffness, and a comb filter on the output tap setting where along the string it is picked. The damping control's cutoff is floored at ten times each string's own pitch rather than being absolute, because as an absolute figure it filtered a high string below its second partial and left almost nothing to hear. Six of the eighteen auto-player patterns are built from a wrapping four-bit adder walking the eight strings around a sixteen-step ring, and those six are shared with Slide.
